notes:
Topline: customer-facing support platform for premium hospitality clients. Primary goal: auto-assist agents + direct tool-calling into backend support systems (Zendesk + in-house OMS) for ticket create/update, refunds, and escalations. Key asks: no duplicate tickets, full audit trail for each tool action, and predictable behavior during event-driven traffic spikes.

POC scope: integrate Redwood tool-calling to create/update Zendesk tickets, call payment gateway for refunds (idempotent), escalate to Ops Slack channel for VIP clients. Evaluate latency under 1) normal load (~50 req/s) and 2) peak spikes (~600 req/s sustained bursts). Must show graceful degradation (fallback to read-only suggestion + queueing) rather than creating partial/ticket duplicates.

Security/compliance: SSO (SAML), KMS-backed keys for any PII tokens, audit logging retained 2 years, and US data residency for payments. Legal insists on an on-prem demo for payment flows before production trial.

Product notes / specifics:
- Preferred models for summarization (short, token-efficient) and separate model variant for tool-calling decisions (lower-latency).
- Must support function-calling style outputs (structured actions) and robust retry semantics (exponential backoff + dedupe key).
- Idempotency key pattern required: external_id + action_type + content_hash. Avoid eventual-duplicate tickets when downstream webhooks lag.
- Need request tracing: token-level cost breakdown and per-request trace id to map to ticket events for audit.

Quote from Head of Ops: "If an assistant suggests a refund, we must be 100% sure we either execute it once or not at all — duplicates are unacceptable."

Decision criteria: reliability under spikes (SLOs for ticket creation success rate), ability to provide structured function outputs, easy connector to our payment gateway, and clear cost model for high-throughput batches. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching and cache layers to reduce gateway calls.

Links: Fireflies ff_20260225_1a9b (call recording), drive deck linked above, initial SOW draft in RDW-1178.

Short-term ask: technical design session w/ infra + payment engineering, share Redwood's idempotency & retry docs, and sample connector for Zendesk create/update with webhooks.
